values.summary: Proposal sent on Wednesday for all six clinics. The operations lead liked the demo; finance wants to see the yearly price first.

values.close-reason: Depot reporting was the deciding feature. They also liked starting with two depots before the rest.

values.at-risk: Northwind Studio has gone quiet since the pricing call. Two other deals are waiting on budgets set in January.
